memories.content: The local's executive board met twice last week without issuing a statement. The local is aware of a rank-and-file caucus leafleting against the port automation memorandum. The local has not yet decided whether to endorse the memorandum or not, and has not yet issued a press release.
The international union endorsed a similar deal at another port last month. The port automation memorandum is a current issue. The local can issue a press release at any time before Monday.
